en-US.longDescription: Convertilla is a simple and convenient program for converting video and music files between various formats. It supports MP4, FLV, MKV, MPG, AVI, MOV, WMV, M4V, 3GP, MP3, WEBM, OPUS, AAC, FLAC, APE, WAV, ASF. We prepared presets for the following devices: Android, iOS (iPhone, iPad), Windows Phone, iPod, Blackberry, Sony PSP and PS3, Microsoft XBOX 360 and Zune, Chrome OS, Ubuntu, Tizen, Nokia N-series and others.
en-US.name: Convertilla

zh-CN.longDescription: Convertilla 是一款简单便捷的视频与音乐文件格式转换工具。它支持 MP4、FLV、MKV、MPG、AVI、MOV、WMV、M4V、3GP、MP3、WEBM、OPUS、AAC、FLAC、APE、WAV、ASF 等多种格式。我们为以下设备准备了预设方案：安卓、iOS（iPhone、iPad）、Windows Phone、iPod、黑莓、索尼 PSP 和 PS3、微软 XBOX 360 和 Zune、Chrome OS、Ubuntu、Tizen、诺基亚 N 系列等。
